"""All-case paired reductions with prior detail, quiet, flat and matching options."""

from collections import defaultdict
from decimal import Decimal, localcontext

import numpy as np
from balanced_spatial_metrics import summarize
from v175_postprocess import ROOT, context, read, ref, source, write_once

plan, post = context()
result = read(ROOT / "scores-v1.json")
assert result["counts"] == dict(wrapper=1644, frozen=1644, network=1500, sampler=7500)
parent = read(plan["parent_scores"]["path"])
old = read(plan["prior_scores"]["path"])
flat = read(plan["earlier_flat_scores"]["path"])
quiet = read(plan["earlier_quiet_scores"]["path"])
spread = read(plan["spread_scores"]["path"])
baseline = read(post["canonical_V172_scores"]["path"])
detail = read(post["V161_current_metrics"]["path"])
assert detail["design"] == plan["design"] and detail["metric_sources"] == plan["metrics_sources"]
assert len(detail["rows"]) == 822 and detail["new_neural_forwards"] == 0
rows = (
    [dict(r, method="parent") for r in parent["rows"] if r["method"] == "parent"]
    + [dict(r) for r in detail["rows"]]
    + [dict(r, method="V169-EMA") for r in old["rows"] if r["method"] == "balanced-EMA"]
    + [dict(r) for r in flat["rows"] if r["method"] == "V171-EMA"]
    + [dict(r) for r in baseline["rows"] if r["method"] == "V172-EMA"]
    + [dict(r) for r in quiet["rows"] if r["method"] == "V173-EMA"]
    + [dict(r) for r in spread["rows"] if r["method"] == "V174-EMA"]
    + result["rows"]
)
assert len(rows) == 9 * 822
maps = {(r["id"], r["method"]): r for r in rows}
assert len(maps) == len(rows)
summary = summarize(rows)
groups = defaultdict(list)
for row in rows:
    groups[row["kind"], row.get("present", row.get("variant", row.get("noise"))), row.get("cohort"), row["method"]].append(row)
checks = 0
maximum = 0.0
for group in summary:
    selected = groups[group["kind"], group["condition"], group["cohort"], group["method"]]
    for field, value in group.items():
        if field in ["kind", "condition", "cohort", "method", "cases"]:
            continue
        with localcontext() as decimal_context:
            decimal_context.prec = 60
            expected = float(sum(Decimal.from_float(float(r[field])) for r in selected) / Decimal(len(selected)))
        difference = abs(expected - value)
        assert difference < 1e-10
        maximum = max(maximum, difference)
        checks += 1
paired = []
for method in plan["methods"]:
    for baseline_method in ["parent", "V161-EMA", "V169-EMA", "V171-EMA", "V172-EMA", "V173-EMA", "V174-EMA"]:
        for (kind, condition, cohort, current), selected in groups.items():
            if current != method or kind == "real":
                continue
            for field in selected[0]:
                if not field.endswith(("DN16", "gain", "error")) or not all(
                    isinstance(r.get(field), (int, float)) and not isinstance(r.get(field), bool)
                    and field in maps[r["id"], baseline_method] for r in selected
                ):
                    continue
                pairs = [dict(id=r["id"], candidate=r[field], baseline=maps[r["id"], baseline_method][field],
                              difference=r[field] - maps[r["id"], baseline_method][field]) for r in selected]
                a, b = [float(np.mean([p[key] for p in pairs])) for key in ["candidate", "baseline"]]
                differences = [p["difference"] for p in pairs]
                paired.append(dict(kind=kind, condition=condition, cohort=cohort, method=method, baseline=baseline_method,
                    field=field, cases=len(pairs), mean_candidate=a, mean_baseline=b, percent_change=100 * (a / b - 1) if b else None,
                    decreased=sum(v < 0 for v in differences), increased=sum(v > 0 for v in differences), equal=sum(v == 0 for v in differences),
                    maximum_increase=max(differences), maximum_decrease=min(differences), pairs=pairs))
write_once(ROOT / "paired-comparisons-v1.json", dict(status="completed-nine-method-fixed-allcase-reductions",
    scores=ref(ROOT / "scores-v1.json"), canonical_V172_scores=post["canonical_V172_scores"], V161_current_metrics=post["V161_current_metrics"],
    prior_scores=plan["prior_scores"], parent_scores=plan["parent_scores"], earlier_flat_scores=plan["earlier_flat_scores"],
    earlier_quiet_scores=plan["earlier_quiet_scores"], spread_scores=plan["spread_scores"], summary=summary, groups=paired,
    independent_Decimal_mean_checks=checks, maximum_Decimal_difference=maximum, methods=9, actual_metric_rows=len(rows),
    new_neural_forwards=0, new_noise_draws=0, source=source(__file__),
    scope="Fixed reused822-case comparison;old V161 EMA arrays re-reduced on identical inputs/metrics before V175 quality. V172 uses its existing audited label-only view;original predictions/records unchanged. This is not a blind cohort or seed-uncertainty estimate."))
for group in paired:
    if group["baseline"] in ["V161-EMA", "V172-EMA"] and group["field"] in ["template_gain", "quiet_error_RMS_DN16", "quiet_spatial_RMS_DN16", "crop_DC_RMS_DN16", "full_error_RMS_DN16", "block32_RMS_DN16", "crop_linear_sRGB_luma_band_gain", "crop_relative_band_error"]:
        print(group["method"], group["baseline"], group["kind"], group["condition"], group["cohort"], group["field"], group["mean_candidate"], group["percent_change"], "decreased/increased", group["decreased"], group["increased"])
print("Decimal checks", checks, "maximum difference", maximum)
